details: Finding good training hyperparameters. At scale, exhaustive sweeps are impossible, so techniques like muP parameterize networks so optimal hyperparameters transfer from small proxy models to large ones.

explainer.lead: muTransfer (muTransfer) is about finding good training hyperparameters; at scale, exhaustive sweeps are impossible, so techniques like muP parameterise networks so optimal hyperparameters transfer from small proxy models to large ones. It matters because it makes large-model tuning affordable.

tiers.eli5: Instead of testing every oven setting on the full-size cake, you find the right settings on a tiny cake and scale them up.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers tune hyperparameters on a small proxy model built with muP-style parameterisation, then transfer the results to the large model. A pitfall is that gains depend on the parameterisation being applied correctly and consistently across model sizes.
tiers.paperLevel: Parameterise the network so that optimal hyperparameters, such as learning rate, are invariant to width, allowing values found on small models to transfer to large ones. Transfer reliability depends on the assumptions of the chosen parameterisation.

explainer.example: A learning rate found on a narrow proxy model is applied unchanged to a much wider model with comparable training behaviour.
